name: bq-customs-valuation
description: Determine 2026 BES customs valuation and its relationship to import duty, ABB and excise. Use for export-sale prices, connected parties, packing, freight, insurance, assists, royalties, excluded costs, alternative valuation methods, evidence and foreign currency. Explains the statutory nil import duty and why it does not remove other import charges or formalities. Includes primary legislation, current authority guidance and a fictional component reconciliation. This source-cited draft holds actual classification, exemptions, customs procedures, exchange-rate evidence, forms and unresolved operational cases. Load with the universal workflow base and BES companions; professional review remains required before reliance.
